newsitem.title: ESTONIA: NORMA TO BE TRADED ON MAIN LIST.
newsitem.headline: NORMA TO BE TRADED ON MAIN LIST.

text.p: Norma , car safety belt manufacturer, will start trading on the main list of the Tallinn stock exchange from August 5, the stock exchange said on Monday.
The market makers for Norma will be Vaartpaberiparniske AS, Hoiupank and Forekspank, the stock exchange said in a statement.
The minimum amount will be 500 and price increments 0.05 kroons.
Estonian Security Service (ESS) will be traded on the secondary list of the exchange from August 5.
The Market makers for ESS will be Vaartpaberiparniske AS, and Hoiupank.
The minimum amount will be 500 and price increments 0.05 kroons.
